mapper.select: SELECT spec_desc as codeId, embryo_code as specdh, material_code as cpdh, actual_arrangement as ydl, begin_date as startDate, end_date as endDate, storage_Location, quality_Grade, (case WHEN instr(bom_data_version,'SZ',1,1)>0 THEN '试制阶段' else '投产阶段' end) as jd FROM T_MDM_MONTH_PLAN_MAIN c,T_MDM_MONTH_PROD_PLAN t where c.month_plan_aps_version = t.month_plan_aps_version and c.del_flag = '0' and t.del_flag='0' and c.year = #{year} AND c.month = #{month} and begin_date is not null and end_date is not null ORDER BY t.month_plan_aps_version,t.material_code,t.embryo_code,t.cx_machine_code DESC

select SCHEDULE_DATE as begin_date,sum(LH_DAY_PLAN) as THEORY_PRODUCTION_PLAN,sum(MOLD_NUMBER) as ACTUAL_ARRANGEMENT from ( SELECT SCHEDULE_DATE,SAP_CODE,SUM( CLASS1_PLAN_QTY + CLASS2_PLAN_QTY + CLASS3_PLAN_QTY ) AS LH_DAY_PLAN,CEIL(SUM( CLASS1_PLAN_QTY + CLASS2_PLAN_QTY + CLASS3_PLAN_QTY ) / (( SELECT PARAM_VALUE FROM T_CX_PARAMS WHERE PARAM_CODE = 'CLASS_SHIFT_MAX_TIME' ) / (( SELECT PARAM_VALUE FROM T_CX_PARAMS WHERE PARAM_CODE = 'BRUSH_BAG_TIME' ) + LH_TIME ) * 3)) AS MOLD_NUMBER FROM T_LH_SCHEDULE_RESULT WHERE TO_CHAR(SCHEDULE_DATE, 'YYYY-MM') = #{month} and DEL_FLAG='0' GROUP BY SAP_CODE,SCHEDULE_DATE,LH_TIME HAVING SUM( CLASS1_PLAN_QTY + CLASS2_PLAN_QTY + CLASS3_PLAN_QTY ) > 0 ) group by SCHEDULE_DATE ORDER BY SCHEDULE_DATE
